# TC-A gate record (contracts/Candidate.sol)

Credit: Taylor (gtmcknight) authored the solved policy, Gaussian filter, replica and qm tables ([amm-sim @4812a638 research/solved](https://github.com/gtmcknight/amm-sim/tree/4812a6382311624e1506aca131ca35c378f930d9/research/solved)). TC-A is port-a of the two-component filter onto qtr2.

This file copies the gate record of TC-A from **A** = [port-a](https://api.imd.fun/artifacts/ebab165bd9bc568057d042f7a9364713eb9cbef3f895e046fc1fde8264134fd2) and, for comparison, of **B** = [port-b](https://api.imd.fun/artifacts/5f15282941e18c32fba78180ce53286fde0f521fc79322ea1d1dc7fa23f60134), a second, independent port of the same reference. All figures are those artifacts' local measurements, not board scores or certified verifier results.
